purpose: official CZU Czech-facing bachelor/master catalogue; homepage total and programme sitemap are cross-checked before every detail page is parsed for teaching language, window, duration, faculty and application target
note: The 2026-09-11 run matched the homepage total 129, sitemap detail total 129 and 129 unique parsed detail pages: 55 bachelor, 74 master, 94 Czech-taught and 35 English-taught. It found complete start/end dates on 128 records; 34 were upcoming, 94 closed and Danube AgriFood Master had no published window. The public REST API is access restricted, so the adapter uses the public homepage count plus the programme sitemap as independent completeness signals. Cross-checking study.czu.cz found two likely English title variants and one additional English-source double-degree record, so the two portals are explicitly reported as disagreeing. The claim excludes doctoral programmes and all output remains candidate-only until source-bound zh-CN/en/cs review.

purpose: cross-check every CZU doctoral offering in the compact MŠMT register baseline against official programme and 2026/2027 admissions evidence from all six doctoral faculties
note: The 2026-09-11T15:12:51Z live run fetched 9/9 official assets with HTTP 200 and matched all 60 MŠMT doctoral offerings across all six doctoral faculties: 30 Czech-taught and 30 English-taught. Every offering has 2026/2027 faculty-window evidence; all 60 were closed at fetch time and await a later academic-year window. Unknown starts never imply open; FTZ's conditional third stage never implies open; the TF image-only regulation is protected by a reviewed SHA-256 transcription. The declared completeness scope does not claim that 2027/2028 windows have or have not been published elsewhere, and output remains candidate-only until source-bound zh-CN/en/cs review.
